description: Search the DesignMD Pro library of website design systems by name, domain, description or category, optionally narrowed to a category and/or design tags. Returns slugs plus a summary (tags, primary color, preview palette, fonts, token counts, Pro/locked status). Pass a slug to get_design_md for the full DESIGN.md. Use list_categories / list_tags to find valid filters.

category.description: Exact category filter (e.g. Developer Tools); see list_categories

query.description: Literal keyword to match against name, domain, description or category, e.g. "linear" or "fintech". Omit to list the latest websites.

tags.description: Design or product tags — matches websites carrying ANY of them (case-insensitive), e.g. ["Dark Mode", "Editorial"]; see list_tags

name: search_websites
title: Search websites
